name: SendGrid
description: SendGrid, now operated under Twilio's platform, is an email API and SMTP service providing email solutions for transactional email at scale and marketing email campaigns.
best_for: SendGrid's page targets both developers integrating transactional email via API/SMTP and marketing teams building email campaigns.
features: Email API for transactional delivery at scale
Access to Twilio's broader communications ecosystem (SMS, voice, Verify)

alternatives.name: Twilio
alternatives.description: The parent communications platform (SMS, voice, video, conversational AI) that now owns and integrates SendGrid's email capability.
alternatives.best_for: Companies wanting email plus other channels (SMS, voice, video) under one platform.

alternatives.name: RapidAPI
alternatives.description: An API marketplace where developers can find and test various email/communication APIs.
alternatives.best_for: Developers comparison-shopping across multiple API providers rather than committing to one vendor.
strengths: Single API key across many providers
